correctness.rationale: All cyclic distances are represented by ≤2 steps as [1,2k] union [ell-k,ell+k], touching since ell<=3k+1, and n/2<=ell+k. Positive bands yield explicit color sets red={ell} or {k,ell}, blue the other short lengths, covering each nonedge by two different generator lengths. Negative middle top n require ell+j all force every short color opposite ell but short-only k+1 has no rainbow path. Negative ell=3k forces short colors by k+j descending and contradicts ell-1/ell-2, while ell=3k+1 distance2k has no two distinct generator-length representation. Independent exhaustive color assignments for k=3..6 across all specified (ell,n) agreed with closed form; proof is general.
